newsitem.title: FINLAND: Hackman ends talks on TTT sale to Simonds.
newsitem.headline: Hackman ends talks on TTT sale to Simonds.

text.p: Finnish consumer goods group Oy Hackman Ab said in a statement on Friday its talks with Simonds Holding of the United States aiming at selling Hackman TTT to Simonds had ended without agreement.
Hackman said the talks had ended without a closing of the deal, but added that Hackman TTT and Simonds would continue talks on potential cooperation.
Hackman TTT manufactures blades and machinery for the mechanical forest industry. Its annual net sales are about 125 million markka, Hackman said.
It announced in October that it had started talks to sell the unit to Simonds.
